name: DPPE (Dense Pose Estimation in a Plenoxels Environment)
definition: A 6-DoF monocular RGB-only pose estimation procedure for Plenoxels environments that recovers the ground truth camera pose after a perturbation by minimizing errors in re-rendering using stochastic gradient descent and numerical gradient approximation.
summary: DPPE is a monocular pose estimation method that uses Plenoxels' fast rendering to numerically approximate gradients, avoiding the slowness of NeRF-based optimizers.
